name: No-code revenue
question: Are people paying for tools that avoid writing code?
metric: Combined annual revenue of Wix and Shopify, latest full year
solvedIf: Most software gets built without writing code
trendLabel: Combined annual revenue of Wix and Shopify, in billions of dollars.
caution: Two public companies stand in for a whole category. Zapier, Webflow and Bubble are private, so they are not counted.
Most of this revenue is not about avoiding code. Shopify earns much of its money from payments, and it grows with online shopping.
rule: Still growing when combined revenue is higher than the year before.
